full_gate.note: This report neither concludes nor replaces the final FULL result.

verified_by_source.criterion: Gerenciamento independent from Forex with Reservas first, Contabilidade second
verified_by_source.observed: management is an independent active-by-default module with its own two screens and routes; Forex has only four operational children. Availability is checked against destination primary before mounting/guards.

verified_by_source.criterion: Legacy routes resolve after accepted navigation and retain draft guards
verified_by_source.observed: forex-reserves targets management-reserves; contab/forex-accounting/exec-accounting/forex-reconciliation target management-accounting; exec/accounting shim uses canonical navigation. Management, Planning, operation and accounts draft guards run before replacing active screen or activating destination.

verified_by_source.criterion: Order migration preserves custom relative order without implicit persistence
verified_by_source.observed: Default eight modules place management after research. Old five/six/seven module formats project in memory; valid custom seven relative orders gain management after research; valid eight retained. Explicit old canonical default receives the deliberate updated default; original preference raw stays intact until explicit Save.

verified_by_source.criterion: Management account/period selection is explicit RAM context and does not switch Forex operation
verified_by_source.observed: Selection initially empty; selectors have explicit empty options; context() returns only own selection, resets at session reset. Reservas queries/submits use JPWManagement.context with null fallback, never operationalSelection. Existing canonical recordReserves and recordAccountLedger remain financial writers.

verified_by_source.criterion: Shared account and period flows honor captured module owner and preserve operational selection
verified_by_source.observed: Management launch passes owner only in accepted management route; dialogs capture before showModal, submit checks captured owner, ownership survives dynamic refresh and Registration/Setup chains. Management cannot activate current period, skips Forex examine/useContext and refreshes selector options without autoselect. Legacy callers keep Forex owner/default behavior.

verified_by_source.criterion: Draft and data preservation integrated with reset/backup/recovery
verified_by_source.observed: Reserve and annual drafts are context-keyed and preserved after explicit decision, retaining captured review rather than silently reauthorizing. Recovery provides read/copy, not automatic replay. managementAnnual optional family validated and included in Backup Completo, existing studies/financial families retained; boot/finalization resets presentation context without deleting confirmed facts.

verified_by_source.criterion: Dashboard, Notes, Dante, historic progress and documentation follow new ownership
verified_by_source.observed: Dashboard uses independent availability before readers and new CTAs; notes screen labels updated; guide preserves moved IDs and retired records without automatic completion, updates track on explicit resume; documentation marks previous contracts historical.

nonblocking_findings.expected: Pending-work ownership query should ideally distinguish the two shared dialog owners.
nonblocking_findings.observed: hasPending(forex) consults aggregate FXConsolidatedUI workState pending; a Management-owned shared form can cause a redundant Forex-work warning.
nonblocking_findings.cause: Legacy global pending query remains; effective dialog owner and captured submit guards were corrected independently.
nonblocking_findings.impact: Orientation warning only; this review found no corresponding financial writer, automatic context switch or continuation override.
nonblocking_findings.disposition: Parent explicitly bounded this iteration to documentation; no adjacent query edit performed.
